snippet.title: Hordes of Fate - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3075410/Hordes_of_Fate__A_Hand_of_Fate_Adventure/

🔥Ahead of Next Fest we are excited to share the latest Hordes of Fate: A Hand of Fate Adventure trailer. 

👉Check out this first glimpse of the next playable hero: 
The Warrior; a fearsome close quarters fighter - then take control and cut your way through the countless hordes in the latest DEMO OUT NOW!
